photos.title: The Caravelle Resort and Tower from above
photos.what: The Caravelle Resort and the Caravelle Tower from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the main building, a tall white-roofed tower with a pool deck along its beach side, stands at the lower left; the Tower, a smaller white-roofed building, stands next door to the north-east; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: The Caravelle's main building and Tower from above, on the beach.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Caravelle Resort main building and the Caravelle Tower on the beach in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the Atlantic Ocean
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the batch 2026-11-a NAIP records (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json).
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Labels by Chapter3 Realty.
